species.real: In the old tale Balor's eye was so deadly that it stayed shut, and it took several men with a polished handle to lever up the lid. Tory Island, off Donegal, is named as his stronghold.
species.name: Balor

dex.text: The one-eyed king of the Fomorians, who kept his great eye shut under heavy lids, because whatever it looked upon withered. Tory was his stronghold, and the storms off the island are said to be him turning over in his sleep.
dex.fact: In Irish myth Balor of the Evil Eye was killed by his own grandson, Lugh, who drove a sling-stone through the eye at the Second Battle of Mag Tuired (Moytura).
